subject.title: refactor(qa): migrate Matrix scenarios into QA Lab

question: After refreshing the dirty head, should an administrator or security reviewer authorize this exact dependency ownership move while accepting the coupled global channel-restart admission behavior?
rationale: Repository policy requires human approval for dependency graph changes, and the gateway lifecycle adjustment has broader production scope than the internal QA migration, so automation cannot safely infer intent.

options.title: Refresh and authorize
options.body: Resolve the dirty state, confirm the lockfile contains only the intended workspace dependency move, approve the exact head, and retain the proven gateway lifecycle change.

options.title: Split gateway lifecycle
options.body: Move the global channel-restart admission adjustment and its tests into a separately reviewed PR before authorizing the narrower QA migration.

options.title: Pause the migration stack
options.body: Hold this PR and its dependent workflow PR until maintainers choose a different ownership or compatibility boundary.

recommendation.title: Refresh and authorize
recommendation.body: Resolve the dirty state, confirm the lockfile contains only the intended workspace dependency move, approve the exact head, and retain the proven gateway lifecycle change.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining gate requires repository-level dependency authorization and acceptance of a cross-cutting gateway lifecycle change.
